messages:
Taryn: Postmortem follow-up — paging cadence + dedupe windows after yesterday's noise spike. Need concrete owners and timelines, and a quick plan to stop duplicate pages. @Leon @Mike can you take initial bits?
Leon: I can own dedupe windows. Will draft settings and test in staging today.
Mike: I'll take paging cadence & escalation rules. My quick suggestion: 3m -> 10m -> 30m with exponential backoff, and a short cooldown per alert group.
Anya: We should also address multi-source duplicates — cache exporter + k8s liveness both firing. Might need source-specific dedupe or labels.
Sarah: Adding the postmortem link here: https://redwoodinc.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1234 — actions listed at the bottom.
incident-bot: New postmortem created: INC-1234 — actions assigned for follow-up.
Taryn: Leon — can you propose concrete dedupe window values? We saw duplicates within ~15s during the spike.
Leon: Proposal: exporter alerts: dedupe_window=60s; k8s-liveness: dedupe_window=120s; add a producer-side suppression label when rollout=true to avoid noisy churn. Will open PR: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/456
Mike: Draft of paging policy snippet I'm going to propose to PD rules: ```yaml
policies:
  - name: high_cpu
    page_after: 3m
    escalate_after: 10m
    final_escalation: 30m
    dedupe_window: 60s
```
Anya: Also advocating for a deploy-suppression feature: when rollout=true for a service, suppress repeated alerts with the same fingerprint for 15m. I can prototype a prometheus alertmanager route for that.
Taryn: Assigning ownership/timelines here: Leon (dedupe windows) — EOD Thu; Mike (paging cadence + PD rules) — EOD Fri; Anya (deploy suppression prototype) — next sprint start. I'll update the ticket and ops board. :thumbsup:
Sarah: I'll add these to the follow-up board and create a weekly checkpoint to look for recurrence patterns.
Leon: Quick Q — do we prefer dedupe at producer (prometheus) or at PagerDuty? Producer dedupe reduces noise earlier but PD-level dedupe prevents multi-cluster floods.
Mike: My take: do producer-side dedupe first for low-hanging wins, keep PD dedupe for safety. We'll document both.
Anya: I'll post a prototype alertmanager route and a prometheus recording rule tonight for review.
Taryn: Great. I'll close the loop in the incident ticket and ping y'all tomorrow in the ops sync. Thanks everyone.
